entries.title: Critics warn of espionage risks, loss of trust within NATO as Slovakia restores military-diplomatic representation with Russia
entries.snippet: Slovakia is restoring military-diplomatic representation with Russia for the first time since 2022. The government has defended the move; critics warn of espionage risks and further damage to trust within NATO.

entries.title: Houthis and Saudis strike each other in latest escalation
entries.snippet: Fighting has continued between Iran-backed rebels and Saudi Arabia, adversely impacting the kingdom's economy and security. Still, Saudi officials have stopped warning of Houthi attacks in an effort to calm fears.

entries.title: Germany: Nuremberg airport closed over in-flight emergency
entries.snippet: Police are investigating a suspected in-flight emergency on a Corfu flight. The plane landed safely in Nuremberg after a fighter jet escort.

entries.title: Spain's King Felipe and Queen Letizia visit Ceuta
entries.snippet: The royal couple have arrived for their first-ever visit to the exclave to show solidarity with residents.

entries.title: Formula 1: Rwanda to bring sport back to Africa
entries.snippet: The last time Formula 1 hosted a race in Africa was way back in 1993. But a new track in Rwanda is set to host a Grand Prix in "the early 2030s" continuing the country’s investment in international sport.

entries.title: Bulgaria condemns Black Sea drone attacks as Russia's war in Ukraine spills over into Eastern Europe

entries.title: Germany's China calculation shifts as import pressures eclipse export benefits
entries.snippet: Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.

entries.title: 125 years of Thomas Mann's 'Buddenbrooks'
entries.snippet: This over 1,000-page masterpiece offers a panoramic view of society in the 19th century and exposes the collapse of a merchant family: unrecognized sons, disillusioned daughters and the loss of middle-class ideals.

entries.title: Pope Leo in Rome hospital for lung surgery

entries.title: What is holding back Cyprus's Schengen ambitions?
entries.snippet: The European Commission says Cyprus is ready to join the Schengen Area. Yet questions relating to the island's division and British military bases could still complicate its path to Europe's border-free travel zone.

entries.title: India opposition to huddle over tea after thousands march in their Delhi protest
entries.snippet: Congress' Rahul Gandhi will reportedly host oppositon MPs for tea after rallying thousands in Monday's election protest. The 'Cockroach' movement says its leaders have been detained during a flash protest. Follow DW.

entries.title: Starlink India launch: Why Elon Musk is still waiting

entries.title: US: Man killed in Six Flags roller coaster incident

entries.title: 'Breaking Bad' actor and disability advocate RJ Mitte dies

entries.title: UK: Iran 'highly likely' to be behind RAF Fairford incident
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told parliament there were "strong indications" of Iranian involvement. The government summoned Iran's ambassador. The scare at RAF Fairford led to the withdrawal of USAF B-1 heavy bombers.

entries.title: Hundreds of French supermarkets hit by a cyberattack that defrosted refrigeration systems
entries.snippet: Hundreds of French supermarkets saw their refrigeration systems defrosted, spoiling tons of frozen food. The unprecedented attack has raised serious questions about food security across Europe.

entries.title: Poland reports arrests of 2 Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with Starlink station fire last month
entries.snippet: Polish authorities have reported the arrests of two Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with alleged sabotage of a Starlink station last month. Prime Minister Donald Tusk called the fire an act of "hybrid warfare."

entries.title: Fact check: Viral videos falsely linked to Riyadh airport attacks
entries.snippet: Many videos claiming to show an attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport have gone viral online. DW Fact check analyzes some of the most-shared footage and finds evidence it was created using AI.
